scope: Corollary C.6 (The peeling character transfer) of the manuscript “From partial permutation information to Fourier bounds” (preprints/From-partial-permutation-information-to-Fourier-bounds-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88926b5e48099ed8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 65. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let b = 222 and partition n = bm points into b sets of size m. Let Hi permute the ith set. If f ≥ 0 has mass at most one and f(gHi) ≤ 2/[Sn : Hi] for every g, i, then for all sufficiently large m and every irreducible of degree D, ∥ b f(ρ)∥2 HS ≤ 6bD−1+(Cpeel+2)/b . (C.2)
